splitByNameOption: Split .fla to small projects according to .sc export names
groupsOption: An array of user-defined regular expressions to split .fla into project groups
groupsOption_details: An array of user-defined regular expressions to split .fla into project groups
- Example, this command will export all export names starting with "bgr": `n!sc2fla file.sc .group=^bgr.*`
- You can also use multiple expressions, but you need to specify group name then, for example: `n!sc2fla file.sc .group=background:^bgr.* .group=character:^char.*`'
as3DocOption: Creates an ActionScript document for the .fla project
as3DocOption_details: Creates an ActionScript document for the .fla project, instead of the SupercellSWF document, for cases where the SupercellSWF plugin is not available
splitToFoldersOption: Creates a .fla file with "Assets" folder divided into additional nested folders
splitToFoldersOption_details: Creates a .fla file with "Assets" folder divided into additional nested folders
- It works almost like split by name into separate .fla, but within single .fla project
- Helps optimise workflow in Animate if there are too many items in "Assets" folder
